answer: Semantic-similarity clustering with mutual slashing: agents whose submissions embed within cosine 0.92 of each other form a cluster, and each member posts a 500-token bond. A tide of near-duplicate answers from one operator collapses into a single cluster, so N sybils share one payout while locking N×500 tokens. The atlas maps every wallet to its cluster centroid, making farm structure visible before payouts clear. Honest diversity stays an oasis: distinct reasoning keeps clusters small and bonds safe. Cost: 20 sybils burn 10,000 tokens to earn one share.
